search_text: published ZDI-16-039 ZDI-CAN-3306 Oracle Application Testing Suite filename Header Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2016-01-25 CVE-2016-0490 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2016-0490 10.0 ['Oracle'] ['Application Testing Suite'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Oracle Application Testing Suite. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the UploadServlet servlet. By providing a filename header containing a directory traversal, an attacker is able to write a file to an arbitrary location on the system.
